patterns.label: Identity return can be replaced by a contract-derived allowlisted transform
patterns.safe_next_step: run verifier gates against the sandbox transform patch
patterns.risk: single-sample transform inference is safe only for allowlisted simple operations

patterns.label: NotImplemented placeholder completion is backed by an explicit literal return contract
patterns.safe_next_step: run verifier gates against the sandbox literal-return patch
patterns.risk: placeholder completion is safe only for narrow literal contracts, not inferred business behavior

patterns.label: Stub completion is backed by an explicit literal return contract
patterns.safe_next_step: run verifier gates against the sandbox literal-return patch
patterns.risk: literal completion is safe only for narrow stub contracts, not inferred business behavior

patterns.label: Callable acceptance passed and no deterministic patch is needed
patterns.safe_next_step: mine upstream tests before adding a new deterministic patch recipe
patterns.risk: may hide a missing business change if upstream intent is underspecified

patterns.label: Guard was derived from signature rather than an explicit negative contract
patterns.safe_next_step: send missing-input contract evidence back to Spec Writer or Implementer before promotion
patterns.risk: signature-derived guard can be mechanically correct but semantically wrong

patterns.label: Executor found no safe bounded source candidate
patterns.safe_next_step: route back to target selection or split native/context boundary as separate work
patterns.risk: project may need a different first slice rather than Executor patching
